title: Noche de Mahjong en Redes Sociales: 4 Personajes en Mesa Flat Lay Surrealista
prompt:
A 9:16 ultra-wide-angle surreal top-down flat lay photography. A group of 4 characters sitting around a square table, one on each side. Camera pulls back significantly, creating massive negative space (empty floor area) around the characters and table, ensuring clean, minimalist composition.

Scene: Characters wearing their classic outfits.

Table is a custom prop designed like a social media post: only top and bottom edges have solid white strips. 
- Top white strip: Avatar image with [A pixel art Kiwi bird], Username "[NZ_Vibes]", time "Just now", "..." icon.
- Bottom white strip: "Comment" icon, "Like" icon (thumbs up), separator line.

Center of table is painted [Matte Black #121212]. Objects on table: [Plate of Fish and Chips, Pavlova, and craft beer bottles].
Important: All objects and interacting hands are strictly confined within this central Black painted area. Nothing extends onto white strips or beyond table. Floor background is [Polished Concrete Grey], creating visual separation. Professional studio lighting with distinct cast shadows. 8K, sharp focus.

Characters: Gundam RX-78-2, Godzilla, Totoro, Astro Boy.
Action: Playing Mahjong. --ar 9:16
